question: dame los identificadores de cliente, envueltos capa a capa
sql:

c2 AS (SELECT customer_sk, level + 1 AS level FROM c1 WHERE level < 8),
c3 AS (SELECT customer_sk, level + 1 AS level FROM c2 WHERE level < 8),
c4 AS (SELECT customer_sk, level + 1 AS level FROM c3 WHERE level < 8),
c5 AS (SELECT customer_sk, level + 1 AS level FROM c4 WHERE level < 8),
